posts.title: Safari 27.3 Beta Release Notes
posts.text:
## Overview

Safari 27.3 beta is available for iOS 27.3 beta, iPadOS 27.3 beta, visionOS 27.3 beta, macOS 27.3 beta, macOS 26, and macOS Sequoia.

### Accessibility

#### Resolved Issues

（13 件は長いため省略）

### Animations

#### New Features

- Added support for running accelerated time-based animations in the remote layer tree to match how accelerated Scroll-driven Animations are run since Safari 26.3. Accelerated animations are animations targeting `transform` and individual transform CSS properties, `opacity`, `filter` and `backdrop-filter`. Animations that target the `offset` property, composed animations, animations that have a `playbackRate` other than 1 and animations that use the `linear()` and `steps()` easing functions are now also accelerated.

#### Resolved Issues

（16 件は長いため省略）

### Browser

#### New Features

- Vertical Tabs introduces a new vertical layout for navigating and managing tabs with a space-efficient design that maximizes webpage content. 

### CSS

#### New Features

- Added support for `hyphenate-limit-chars` to set the minimum word length and the minimum number of characters before and after a hyphenation break.
- Added support for `@supports at-rule(...)` conditions.
- Added support for the `path()` and `shape()` functions in `shape-outside`.
- Added support for a custom `<string>` value in `text-overflow`, so overflowing inline content can be truncated with any string instead of only `clip` or `ellipsis`.
- Added support for the extended numeric range in longhand East Asian counter styles.
- Added support for the `object-view-box` property.
- Added support for the `attr()` function.
- Added support for `property-scoped` and `property-index-scoped` caching keywords in `random()`.
- Added support for `outline-offset: inset`.
- Added support for the `@function` custom functions rule.
- Added support for the `if()` function.
- Added support for the `random-item()` function.
- Added support for `calc-mix()`.
- Added support for `justify-self` on block-level boxes.
- Added support for a comma-separated list of conditions in `@container` queries.
- Added support for `CSSContainerRule.conditions`.
- Added support for the `content` property on the `::marker` pseudo-element.
- Added support for the `text-decoration-inset` property.
- Added support for the `white-space-trim` property.
- Added support for the `wrap-inside` property.
- Added support for `@supports named-feature()` conditions.
- Added support for `HighlightRegistry.highlightsFromPoint()`.
- Added support for `random()` in custom properties.
- Added support for the `ident()` function.
- Added support for the `inherit()` function.
- Added support for `CSSConditionRule.supports`.
- Added support for the `corner-shape` property.
- Added support for the unprefixed `user-select` CSS property.
- Added support for `CSSMediaRule.matches`.
- Added support for using `sibling-index()` and `sibling-count()` within container query conditions.
- Added support for `::highlight` to style all custom highlights at once.
- Added support for the unprefixed `hyphenate-limit-lines` property, including interpolation, while keeping `-webkit-hyphenate-limit-lines` as an alias.

#### Resolved Issues

（91 件は長いため省略）

#### Deprecations

- Removed the non-standard `percentage` value from `-webkit-line-clamp`.
- Removed `margin-trim` support from grid containers, following the CSSWG resolution limiting it to block and multi-column containers.

### HTML

#### New Features

- Added support for the `Origin-Agent-Cluster` header. `document.domain` remains accessible by default, and the header can be used to disable it.
- Added support for the `headingoffset` and `headingreset` attributes.
- Added support for `popover=hint`.
- Added support for the `interactive-widget` key in the viewport `<meta>` tag, with the values `resizes-visual`, `resizes-content`, and `overlays-content`, to control how the page responds when the on-screen keyboard appears.

#### Resolved Issues

（16 件は長いため省略）

### Images

#### Resolved Issues

（1 件は長いため省略）

### JavaScript

#### New Features

- Added support for `Iterator.prototype.includes()`.
- Added support for Explicit Resource Management, including `Symbol.dispose`.
- Added support for `Temporal`, a modern API for working with dates and times.
- Added support for deferred module evaluation with `import defer`.
- Added support for `Iterator.prototype.join()`.
- Added support for iterator chunking, including `Iterator.prototype.chunks()` and `Iterator.prototype.windows()`.
- Added support for the joint iteration proposal, including `Iterator.zip()` and `Iterator.zipKeyed()`.
- Added support for importing text modules with an import attribute of `type: text`.
- Added support for `BigInt` values in `Intl.PluralRules.prototype.select` and `Intl.PluralRules.prototype.selectRange`.

#### Resolved Issues

（34 件は長いため省略）

### Navigation API

#### New Features

- Added support for the `to` property on `NavigationTransition`.
- Added support for intercepting a navigation with a precommit handler.

（4 件は長いため省略）

### Networking

#### New Features

- Added support for streaming request bodies in `fetch()` by passing a `ReadableStream` as the `body`.

#### Resolved Issues

（5 件は長いため省略）

### Rendering

#### New Features

- Added support for dark mode in the XML document viewer.
- Added Adaptive Dark Mode, which automatically adapts bright web pages that don’t natively support dark mode, giving users an optimized viewing experience when browsing at night or in dark environments. 

#### Resolved Issues

（60 件は長いため省略）

### SVG

#### New Features

- Added support for `text-overflow` as an SVG presentation attribute.
- Added support for `fill` and `stroke` referencing paint servers in external SVG documents.
- Added support for SVG external resources, allowing `url()` references to SVG resources such as filters, masks, and gradients in external documents.
- Added support for the SVG 2 `path` attribute on `<textPath>`, which lets text follow an inline path without referencing a separate `<path>` element via `href`.

#### Resolved Issues

（13 件は長いため省略）

#### Deprecations

- Removed the `use-script`, `no-change`, and `reset-size` values from `dominant-baseline` to match SVG 2.

#### Resolved Issues

（3 件は長いため省略）

### Security

#### New Features

- Added support for viewing 2-QWAC certification information for a webpage. 

#### Resolved Issues

（2 件は長いため省略）

### Spatial Web

#### New Features

- Added preview support for Spatial CSS Portals and Connected Volumetric Scenes in visionOS. To preview, enable the Spatial CSS Portals feature in Settings. 

#### Resolved Issues

（1 件は長いため省略）

### Web API

#### New Features

- Added support for `QuotaExceededError` as a `DOMException` subclass, exposed on `window` and worker global scopes.
- Added support for subgroups in WebGPU.
- Added support for close watchers and the `closedby` attribute for `dialog` elements.
- Added support for requesting OpenID4VP credentials with the Digital Credentials API. 
- Added support for `getAllRecords()` and `IDBGetAllOptions` in IndexedDB.
- Added support for serializing and storing `FileSystemHandle` objects.
- Added support for creating dedicated workers from shared workers.
- Added support for a `stack` property on `DOMException`, matching other error objects.

#### Resolved Issues

（22 件は長いため省略）

#### Deprecations

- Removed the non-standard `DataTransferItemList.prototype.item()` method to match the HTML specification; use index access such as `items[0]` instead.

#### Resolved Issues

（7 件は長いため省略）

### Web Extensions

#### New Features

- Added support for `setAccessLevel()` on the `local` and `sync` storage areas.
- Added support for the `offscreen` API.
- Added support for `scripting.ExecutionWorld`.

#### Resolved Issues

（5 件は長いため省略）

### Web Inspector

#### New Features

- Added support for throttling the network speed of the inspected page.
- Added support for the range mappings proposal in source maps.
- Added per-element `Layout Invalidated` events in Web Inspector to reflect the number of elements affected by a layout invalidation.
- Added support for editing WebGPU shaders in the Canvas tab.
- Added support for highlighting WebGPU render pipelines in the Canvas tab.
- Improved the estimated memory use of WebGL and WebGPU canvases to include their GPU resources, such as textures and buffers.
- Added support for showing object arguments and return values in Canvas recordings.
- Added support for showing flag names, such as `GPUBufferUsage.COPY_DST`, instead of raw numbers in WebGPU Canvas recordings.
- Added syntax highlighting to actions in Canvas recordings.
- Added logging of the site-specific quirks active on a page to the Web Inspector console.

#### Resolved Issues

（20 件は長いため省略）

### WebAssembly

#### New Features

- Added support for relaxed SIMD instructions.
- Added support for WebAssembly Memory64.

#### Resolved Issues
